body.en: Queensway emerged as a shopping and residential complex.
body.zh: Queensway 在这一时期形成商住综合体。

caution.en: Sources give 1974, 1975 or 1976; the opening year remains unresolved.
caution.zh: 来源分别记载1974、1975或1976年，确切开业年份尚未核实。

body.en: An archival photograph records the mall’s interior in 1975.
body.zh: 历史照片记录了1975年的商场内部。

caution.en: A photograph date does not establish the opening year; image reuse rights need checking.
caution.zh: 照片日期不能确定开业年份；图像再使用权限尚待核查。

body.en: An archival photograph records the mall’s exterior in 1977.
body.zh: 历史照片记录了1977年的商场外观。

caution.en: The image does not establish a refurbishment date; reuse rights need checking.
caution.zh: 照片不能确定翻修日期；图像再使用权限尚待核查。

body.en: IKEA opened a flagship store and warehouse diagonally opposite Queensway.
body.zh: IKEA 在 Queensway 斜对面开设旗舰店及仓库。

caution.en: No causal effect on Queensway’s rents or footfall has been established.
caution.zh: 尚无证据证明该事件对 Queensway 租金或客流的因果影响。

body.en: Queensway appears in My Community’s Queenstown heritage-trail publication.
body.zh: Queensway 被收录于 My Community 的女皇镇历史步道出版物。

caution.en: Inclusion in a heritage trail is not statutory conservation protection.
caution.zh: 被收录于历史步道不等于获得法定保育保护。

body.en: Reporting dates the formation of the collective sale committee to 2018.
body.zh: 报道记载，集体出售委员会于2018年成立。

caution.en: Committee formation does not mean consent thresholds were met or a sale agreed.
caution.zh: 委员会成立不代表已达到同意门槛或达成出售。

body.en: An extraordinary general meeting approved proceeding with signatures to the collective sale agreement.
body.zh: 特别业主大会通过动议，推进集体出售协议的签署。

caution.en: The motion does not confirm the first signature date, required consent or a public tender.
caution.zh: 该动议不能确定首个签署日期，也不代表达到同意门槛或已公开招标。

body.en: An agent estimated the proposed mixed-use collective sale at more than S$500 million.
body.zh: 经纪人估计，拟议商住整体集体出售的价值超过5亿新元。

caution.en: A 2019 agent estimate, not a reserve price, completed transaction or current valuation.
caution.zh: 这是2019年的经纪人估计，并非底价、成交价或当前估值。

title.zh: 通知租户整售尝试终止

body.en: The agent said tenants were notified in October that the collective-sale attempt had ended.
body.zh: 经纪人表示，租户于10月获通知，集体出售尝试已终止。

caution.en: Only the month is verified; the original notice has not been obtained.
caution.zh: 仅核实到月份，尚未取得原始通知。

body.en: Savills confirmed that the attempt had ended without the required consent.
body.zh: Savills 确认，整售尝试因未取得所需同意而终止。

caution.en: The exact support was not disclosed; this was not a completed sale or failed buyer tender.
caution.zh: 准确支持比例未披露；这并非已完成的出售，也非买方招标流标。

body.en: A 2,734 sq ft third-floor unit was offered at a S$7.5 million guide price.
body.zh: 一个面积2,734平方英尺的三楼单位，以750万新元指导价挂牌。

caution.en: One unit’s asking price is not a transaction price or mall-wide valuation.
caution.zh: 单个单位的挂牌价不等于成交价或整个商场的估值。

body.en: Mall management promoted three vintage and thrift businesses with their unit locations.
body.zh: 商场管理方推广了三家古着及二手商家，并列出店铺位置。

caution.en: The promotion date does not establish when the shops opened or a growth rate.
caution.zh: 推广日期不能确定店铺开业时间，也不能据此计算业态增长率。

title.zh: 体育零售与二手业态并存

body.en: CNA described sports retailers and secondhand shops operating alongside one another.
body.zh: CNA 报道了体育零售商与二手店并存的经营现状。

caution.en: Observations and interviews are not a measured mall-wide trading or footfall trend.
caution.zh: 报道观察与访谈不等于经过测量的全商场经营或客流趋势。

body.en: Four retailers share their experiences.
body.zh: 四位零售商分享经历。

caution.en: Not a tenant census.
caution.zh: 并非商户普查。

body.en: The mall’s directory links sports businesses to shop units for field verification.
body.zh: 商场目录将体育商家与店铺单位对应，可供实地核查。

caution.en: Directory entries do not prove current operation or provide a complete occupancy census.
caution.zh: 目录记录不能证明当日实际营业，也不构成完整的入驻普查。

body.en: Majority consent replaced unanimity for qualifying collective sales.
body.zh: 符合条件的集体出售由全体同意转向多数同意。

caution.en: Later requirements, including the strata-area test, must be distinguished from the 1999 change.
caution.zh: 后续要求，包括分层面积门槛，须与1999年的制度变更区分。

body.en: URA restricted commercial strata subdivision in specified Central Area locations and incentive schemes.
body.zh: URA 限制指定 Central Area 地区及激励计划项目的商业分层细分。

caution.en: Applicability to Queensway has not been established; this is not a nationwide ban.
caution.zh: Queensway 的适用性尚未核实；这不是全国性禁令。

body.en: Land Betterment Charge replaced the Development Charge, Differential Premium and Temporary Development Levy regimes.
body.zh: 土地增值费取代原有的 Development Charge、Differential Premium 与 Temporary Development Levy 制度。

caution.en: This does not establish a charge payable for Queensway.
caution.zh: 这不代表 Queensway 已产生缴费义务。

body.en: Qualifying new and renewed retail leases became subject to the Code of Conduct.
body.zh: 符合条件的新签及续签零售租约须遵守租赁行为准则。

status.zh: 适用于符合条件的租约

caution.en: Coverage depends on signing or renewal date, duration and use; existing leases are not all automatically covered.
caution.zh: 适用性取决于签约或续约日期、租期及用途；并非所有存量租约自动适用。

body.en: Master Plan 2025 became the statutory land-use plan.
body.zh: 2025年总体规划正式成为法定土地利用规划。

caution.en: Zoning is not an individual redevelopment approval; subsequent amendments also require checking.
caution.zh: 土地用途分区不等于个别重建项目获批；后续修订仍需核查。

body.en: The open Master Plan 2025 land-use dataset was updated.
body.zh: 2025年总体规划土地利用开放数据集更新。

caution.en: A dataset update is not evidence that Queensway’s zoning changed on that date.
caution.zh: 数据集更新不代表 Queensway 的用途分区在当日发生改变。

title.zh: 提出集体出售制度修法

body.en: An amendment bill proposed age-based consent tiers and additional owner safeguards.
body.zh: 修正法案提出按楼龄分级的同意门槛，并增加业主保障。

caution.en: Introduction of a bill is not its commencement.
caution.zh: 法案提出不等于已经生效。

body.en: The September 2026 Land Betterment Charge rate table took effect.
body.zh: 2026年9月土地增值费费率表开始适用。

caution.en: Queensway’s applicable geographical sector and any liability have not been verified.
caution.zh: 尚未核实 Queensway 对应的地理费率分区及任何缴费义务。

title.zh: 集体出售修法获议会通过

body.en: Parliament passed amendments to the collective-sale regime.
body.zh: 议会通过集体出售制度修正案。

caution.en: Passage does not establish when the amendments take effect.
caution.zh: 议会通过不能确定修法的生效日期。

body.en: The official statutory index records presidential assent to the amendment Act.
body.zh: 官方法令索引记载，修正法获总统批准。

status.zh: 已获批准；依据官方索引

caution.en: Assent is distinct from commencement; the full statutory page was inaccessible.
caution.zh: 总统批准与生效不同；本次未能访问完整法令页面。

body.en: The official statutory index records publication of the Act, including new consent tiers for older developments.
body.zh: 官方法令索引记载修正法公布，其中包括针对老龄项目的新同意门槛。

caution.en: The commencement notice has not been verified; do not apply the new tiers to Queensway automatically.
caution.zh: 尚未核实生效通知；不能直接将新门槛套用于 Queensway。
